user.title: Connect the Baseus companion
user.description: Enter the companion URL including http:// or https:// and its LOCAL API key. Baseus cloud login is available after setup under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the companion. Check its URL and network access.
error.invalid_auth: The local API key was rejected.

settings.title: Snapshots and storage
settings.description: One schedule for all cameras. Interval starts after a capture cycle finishes. Frequent wake-ups consume battery. Archive requires a mounted directory in the companion container.

data.skip_frames: Skip initial frames for camera date/time

cloud_login.title: Explicit Baseus login
cloud_login.description: WARNING: a new login may sign out your phone/tablet. This is a one-time action, not automatic re-login. Password is used in memory only; just the resulting cloud session is saved. Use HTTPS or a trusted local network between HA and companion. Region is set by BASEUS_COUNTRY in Docker.

data.confirm_session_reset: I understand a new login may sign out other devices

login_success.title: Login successful
login_success.description: Baseus accepted the login. The session is saved and capture scheduling has resumed. Account/password were not saved. Camera connectivity is checked separately during capture.

login_rejected.title: Login rejected
login_rejected.description: Baseus rejected the login. Check account, password and Docker region. No automatic retry was made. Account/password were not saved.

login_error.title: Could not complete login
login_error.description: Network, cloud or storage error. No automatic retry was made. Check companion logs; do not share credentials.

login_unknown.title: Login result not confirmed
login_unknown.description: HA stopped waiting or lost connection. The server may still complete login. Check Cloud session status before trying again; no automatic repeat was made.

auth_valid.title: Cloud session accepted
auth_valid.description: The session was accepted at the last cloud check/login; future expiry is still possible. Account/password are not stored. Last login progress/result is also available in the Cloud session sensor attributes.

auth_missing.title: No saved session
auth_missing.description: No usable session was found for the configured region. Use Sign in to Baseus or import a working session. Account/password are not stored.

auth_rejected.title: Cloud session rejected
auth_rejected.description: A token is present but was rejected on the last check. Automatic re-login is disabled. Explicit login or a working imported session is required.

auth_unknown.title: Session not yet verified
auth_unknown.description: A saved session exists but has not been checked since this service start. Token presence alone does not prove successful login.

auth_running.title: Cloud login in progress
auth_running.description: The explicitly requested login is still running. Wait and check the Cloud session sensor. Do not submit another login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not save settings to the companion.
error.confirm_required: Confirm the risk of signing out other devices before logging in.
error.busy: The companion is capturing or logging in. Wait and try again.
error.login_start_failed: Login start was not confirmed. Check connection, API key and companion version (0.2.0+). Check Cloud session status before repeating: the server may have accepted the request.

progress.cloud_login: Waiting for the explicitly requested Baseus login. Credentials will not be submitted again.

abort.update_companion: Update the companion container to version 0.2.0 or newer.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not read the companion status.
